The game features over 10 high-resolution animated HCGs. Each victory unlocks exclusive interactive events, including intimate conversations, pose variations, and even special voice lines.

Players will experience both the thrill of psychological battles and the ultimate tease to the senses.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45537850/6bfaa344436a2165602a6533143003640aecd4e8.png[/img]

In addition to the signature succubus dealer, multiple characters with unique personalities and seductive styles will appear.

As the game progresses, players will uncover their secrets and descend deeper into this labyrinth of desire.
